newsitem.title: USA: Professional Staff acquires British firm.
newsitem.headline: Professional Staff acquires British firm.

text.p: Professional Staff Plc said Thursday it has definitively agreed to acquire Salisbury Consulting Group, a British company providing placement and staffing for scientific needs.

The value of the deal was not disclosed, but Professional Staff said consideration will consist of cash, potential payments linked to Salisbury's performance and options on its shares for certain Salisbury management and employees.

Professional Staff, whose principal subsidiary Lab Staff provides laboratory scientists and technicians in Britain, said Salisbury has a strong client base in the pharmaceutical sector. It said Salisbury also offers technical staffing for the telecommunications and construction industries.
The company's revenue for the nine months ended March 31, 1997 was $5.76 million, Professional Staff said.
Professional Staff said acquiring Salisbury is an important first step in fulfilling its external growth strategy.

"Salisbury has key client relationships and strength in a range of science segments which can be leveraged through our established branch network," a company statement said. "We are confident that Salisbury will make a positive contribution to the company's earnings in fiscal 1998."
It said Rod Unger will continue as chief executive of Salisbury and join the Professional Staff board.
